properties.name: simply-connect.api-key
properties.description: Secret External API key. Prefer an environment variable and never commit it.

properties.name: simply-connect.base-url
properties.description: Simply Connect API server root URL.

properties.name: simply-connect.default-sms-endpoint-id
properties.description: Optional default endpoint used by convenience SMS methods.

properties.name: simply-connect.panel.enabled
properties.description: Enables the embedded developer panel. Keep disabled in public production environments unless explicitly required.

properties.name: simply-connect.panel.path
properties.description: Application-relative path of the developer panel.

properties.name: simply-connect.panel.password
properties.description: Separate password for the developer panel; at least 12 characters and never equal to the API key.
